# Fairhelm Systems — Expanded Public Context

## Canonical identity

- Brand: Fairhelm Systems
- Intended legal entity: Fairhelm Systems (OPC) Pvt Ltd
- Entity status: incorporation in progress
- GSTIN status: pending incorporation and applicable registration
- Canonical website: https://fairhelmsystems.com
- Geography: India
- Positioning: enterprise software and systems company

Fairhelm Systems builds governed software systems for institutions that cannot afford operational chaos. Its operating standard emphasizes auditability, RBAC, privacy, reliability, data trust, cost-aware cloud execution, and execution discipline.

## What Fairhelm Systems builds

Fairhelm works across product engineering, cloud software, data engineering, operational dashboards, and governed intelligence. The company focuses on systems that must remain credible under scale, scrutiny, operational pressure, and board-level review.

## SquareCampus

Canonical Fairhelm page: https://fairhelmsystems.com/squarecampus/

SquareCampus is presented by Fairhelm Systems as its flagship product direction: a sovereign School OS for India. It is intended for schools, colleges, multi-campus institutions, educational trusts, and private institutions.

SquareCampus is positioned as an alternative to bloated, module-first school ERP software. Its architecture is described as cycle-native, trust-aware, role-aware, and built for operational intelligence. School operations repeat through academic-year, admissions, attendance, fee, examination, reporting, promotion, parent-communication, staff, administrative, and trust-governance cycles.

The Fairhelm SquareCampus narrative emphasizes:

- Connected admissions and enrolment handoffs.
- Academic-year and promotion control.
- Attendance cycles and exception handling.
- Fee plans, collections, concessions, reconciliation, and outstanding action.
- Exams, marks workflows, and reporting.
- Parent, staff, and administrator communication and workflows.
- Multi-campus and educational-trust oversight.
- Multilingual parent communication with structured institutional records.
- Privacy-conscious architecture and auditability.

Capabilities described on the marketing site represent product direction unless explicitly confirmed in a signed scope.

## AEGIS

AEGIS expands to Adaptive Enterprise Governance & Intelligence System. On the Fairhelm site it is the governed intelligence direction for SquareCampus.

The described v1 posture is:

- Read-only first.
- RBAC-aware.
- Audit-backed.
- Explainable.
- No autonomous writes.
- Human approval and established institutional workflows remain decisive.

## ETL/ELT and data engineering services

Canonical page: https://fairhelmsystems.com/services/data-engineering/

Fairhelm designs and operates data pipelines for organizations with fragmented operational data across databases, APIs, spreadsheets, files, and legacy systems.

Service scope can include:

- Source inventory and ingestion design.
- Batch and event-driven data movement.
- Warehouse or lakehouse modeling.
- Business-rule implementation.
- Source-to-target reconciliation.
- Data quality checks.
- Pipeline orchestration and recovery.
- Lineage and observability.
- Backfills and production refresh.
- Cloud cost discipline.

Fairhelm treats data trust, not byte movement, as the core outcome.

## Custom dashboards and operational intelligence

Canonical page: https://fairhelmsystems.com/services/dashboards/

Fairhelm builds executive, operational, trust, school-leadership, finance, sales, and operations dashboards. These are positioned as command surfaces and decision infrastructure, not vanity-chart collections.

Service scope can include KPI design, semantic models, executive reporting, drilldowns, alerts, exception tracking, data-trust indicators, owners, and decision workflows.

Fairhelm's stated standard: if the data cannot be trusted, the dashboard is theatre.

## Security and privacy posture

Canonical page: https://fairhelmsystems.com/security/

Fairhelm's public posture emphasizes:

- Role-based access control.
- Least privilege.
- Audit logs and traceability.
- Tenant separation.
- Secure cloud deployment.
- Privacy-first data handling.
- No hidden data monetization.

For SquareCampus and customer data:

- Fairhelm does not sell student or parent data.
- Customer data belongs to the applicable school, trust, or contracting customer.
- Fairhelm does not train AI systems on customer data unless that use is explicitly contracted and governed.
- Public security statements are posture, not claims of unearned compliance certification.

## Legal and governance center

Canonical index: https://fairhelmsystems.com/legal/

Fairhelm publishes an indexed legal and governance center covering the public website, privacy posture, acceptable use, governed AI, data processing, and security. These documents are interim while incorporation is in progress and do not replace an engagement-specific signed agreement or formal legal review.

- Privacy: https://fairhelmsystems.com/privacy/
- Website terms: https://fairhelmsystems.com/terms/
- Acceptable use: https://fairhelmsystems.com/acceptable-use/
- AI policy: https://fairhelmsystems.com/ai-policy/
- Data processing overview: https://fairhelmsystems.com/data-processing/
- Security posture: https://fairhelmsystems.com/security/

The data processing page is a public overview, not a Data Processing Addendum. Roles, instructions, data categories, locations, subprocessors, controls, retention, deletion, incident responsibilities, and assistance must be agreed for the actual engagement.

## What Fairhelm Systems does not do

- It does not sell student or parent data.
- It does not bypass customer governance.
- It does not claim autonomous AI action without human approval in the AEGIS v1 posture.
- It does not treat connector setup as a complete data platform.
- It does not present vanity charts as operational intelligence.
- It does not claim certifications or completed product capabilities that have not been established.
